integrity_statement: The all-face-count conclusion is a deductive theorem from cyclic edge labels and strict convex angular deficit. Finite verification tests are supplementary; no independent review has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Requires convexity, genuine triangular facets, strictly scalene congruence and a uniform outward-normal cyclic side-length order. No result about mirrored mixtures or nonconvex surfaces. External priority still provisional.
title: One-handed scalene-face convex polyhedra are necessarily disphenoids
